SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_no, r.member_id, m.member_name, m.phone AS member_phone, COALESCE(r.golf_course_id, t.golf_course_id) AS golf_course_id, gc.course_name, r.tee_time_id, t.course, COALESCE(r.play_at, t.play_date + t.start_time) AS play_at, r.player_count, r.reservation_status, r.total_amount, r.reserved_at
ORDER BY play_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.reservation_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
